description: Write comprehensive tests for the template renderer covering all template features: element rendering, expression output (escaped/raw), inheritance, partials, control flow, auto-escaping, style-embed, doctype, HTMX injection, and end-to-end integration with the Phase 3 render call.
steps: Create tests/test_templates.nim with import of unittest, renderer, lexer, parser, ast, response modules

Suite: 'Renderer - Element Rendering' - test basic tags (div, p, h1), class shorthand (div.post-card, div.card.highlighted), ID shorthand (input#email), combined class+ID (div#sidebar.panel.dark), attributes (a href="/posts" "All Posts"), void elements (img, input, br, hr, meta, link), HTMX attributes (button hx-post="/vote" hx-target="#count" "Vote")

Suite: 'Renderer - Expression Output' - test escaped output (h1= post.title with HTML chars), raw output (div!= post.html_body), string interpolation in text ("Hello #{user.name}"), interpolation in attributes (a href="/posts/#{post.id}")
Suite: 'Renderer - Auto-Escaping' - test that < > & " ' are escaped in = output, test that != bypasses escaping, test interpolation escaping in strings

Suite: 'Renderer - Inheritance' - test extends with single block, multiple named blocks, default block values (block title || "Doot App"), deep inheritance chains (child extends parent extends grandparent), block override replaces parent content
Suite: 'Renderer - Partials' - test partial inclusion with locals, test that partials do NOT inherit parent scope (explicit locals only), test recursive partials (a partial includes another partial)
Suite: 'Renderer - Control Flow' - test each loop iteration, test if/else conditional rendering, test if collection.empty? check, test nested control flow (if inside each)
Suite: 'Renderer - Doctype' - test doctype html renders <!DOCTYPE html>
Suite: 'Renderer - Style Embed' - test style-embed "app.css" reads file and wraps in <style> tag
Suite: 'Renderer - HTMX Injection' - test that HTMX script tag is auto-injected in layouts with a <head> element

Suite: 'Renderer - Integration' - test end-to-end render call: create a handler that calls renderResponse with locals, verify complete HTML output with layout inheritance, escaped content, and correct structure
Add test_templates.nim to doot.nimble test task list
acceptance_criteria: All new template tests pass (nim c -r tests/test_templates.nim succeeds)
Tests cover every exit criterion from Phase 4 spec
Tests use real template parsing (tokenize in Template mode, parse, then render) not just hand-constructed AST
Tests verify actual HTML output strings match expected
